author: PlayStation
description:
Celebrate the anniversary of Jackie Robinson’s historic MLB Debut as he broke Major League Baseball’s color barrier. Play all new Storylines, collect Negro Leagues Legends, explore the new Conquest map and more. Available now (USA only) is the Jackie Robinson Foundation Pack – until April 29 2026, all proceeds after store platform fee deductions are applied to the Jackie Robinson Foundation.

Details: 
Your purchase of the Jackie Robinson Foundation Pack grants you: 5,000 Stubs™, the Jackie Robinson Foundation (JRF) bat skin, two additional Jackie Robinson themed bat skins, Jackie Robinson socks, Jackie Robinson bat grip, a profile icon and a #42 profile icon for use in MLB® The Show™ 26. Once acquired, items can be redeemed upon booting the game. Information on items redeemed should be listed in your Profile mail inbox. These items are not eligible to be sold on the Online Marketplace.

Until April 29th, 2026, PlayStation will donate 100% of the proceeds (a minimum of $3.49 per pack
title: MLB The Show 26 - Jackie Robinson Day and Storylines Update | PS5 Games

Wishlist now Tour de France 2026 on PlayStation 5!

Mastering the peloton is no longer just about power and stamina. In Tour de France 2026, you'll have to master the weather!

This video details the brand-new weather system, a feature that brings unprecedented realism and strategic depth. Before each stage, check the forecast to anticipate the conditions, but beware—a surprise shower can always hit in the final kilometers! See how rain and temperature affect your race, from forcing riders into long-sleeved jerseys to making every descent a test of skill. Adapt your gameplay, manage your rider's agility, and survive the storm to ride to victory.

Experience the most immersive Tour de France game yet, coming June 4, 2026, to PlayStation 5.
